arxiv-2109-06168.title: Generatively Augmented Neural Network Watchdog for Image Classification Networks
arxiv-2109-06168.creator: Justin M. Bui, Glauco A. Amigo, Robert J. Marks II, PhD
arxiv-2109-06168.description: Abstract The identification of out-of-distribution data is vital to the deployment of classification networks. For example, a generic neural network that has been trained to differentiate between images of dogs and cats can only classify an input as either a dog or a cat.

arxiv-2206-08711.title: Ballistic transport of interacting Bose particles in the tight-binding chain
arxiv-2206-08711.creator: P. S. Muraev 1,2 , D. N. Maksimov 1,3 , and A. R. Kolovsky 1,2
arxiv-2206-08711.description: Abstract It is known that quantum transport of non-interacting Bose particles across the tight-binding chain is ballistic in the sense that the current does not depend on the chain length. We address the question whether the transport of strongly interacting bosons can be ballistic as well.

arxiv-2207-11288.title: Satellite shadows through stellar occultations
arxiv-2207-11288.creator: Paul J. Groot
arxiv-2207-11288.description: Abstract Aims. The impact of mega-constellations of satellites in low-Earth orbit during nighttime optical observations is assessed. Methods. Orbital geometry is used to calculate the impact of stellar occultations by satellites on the photometry of individual stars as well as the effect on the photometric calibration of wide-field observations. Results. Starlink-type satellites will have occultation disks several arcseconds across.

arxiv-2301-05022.title: Progress on the study of the Ginibre ensembles II: G in OE and G in SE
arxiv-2301-05022.creator: Sung-Soo Byun, Peter J. Forrester
arxiv-2301-05022.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Sung-Soo Byun, Peter J. Forrester. This is part II of a review relating to the three classes of random non-Hermitian Gaussian matrices introduced by Ginibre in 1965. While part I restricted attention to the GinUE (Ginibre unitary ensemble) case of complex elements, in this part the cases of real elements (GinOE, denoting Ginibre orthogonal ensemble) and quaternion elements represented as 2 × 2 2\times 2 complex blocks (GinSE, denoting Ginibre symplectic ensemble) are considered.

arxiv-2402-09934.title: Paying Attention to Deflections: Mining Pragmatic Nuances for Whataboutism Detection in Online Discourse
arxiv-2402-09934.creator: Khiem Phi, Noushin Salek Faramarzi, Chenlu Wang, Ritwik Banerjee
arxiv-2402-09934.description: Abstract Whataboutism, a potent tool for disrupting narratives and sowing distrust, remains under-explored in quantitative NLP research. Moreover, past work has not distinguished its use as a strategy for misinformation and propaganda from its use as a tool for pragmatic and semantic framing.

arxiv-2501-04258.title: How Large is the Universe of RNA-Like Motifs? A Clustering Analysis of RNA Graph Motifs Using Topological Descriptors
arxiv-2501-04258.creator: Rui Wang ID, Tamar Schlick ∗ ID
arxiv-2501-04258.description: Abstract Identifying novel and functional RNA structures remains a significant challenge in RNA motif design and is crucial for developing RNA-based therapeutics. Here we introduce a computational topology-based approach with unsupervised machine-learning algorithms to estimate the database size and content of RNA-like graph topologies.

arxiv-2503-16602.title: Efficient use of quantum computers for collider physics
arxiv-2503-16602.creator: Christian W. Bauer
arxiv-2503-16602.description: Abstract Most observables at particle colliders involve physics at a wide variety of distance scales. Due to asymptotic freedom of the strong interaction, the physics at short distances can be calculated reliably using perturbative techniques, while long distance physics is non-perturbative in nature.

arxiv-2507-03583.title: Impact of a binary companion in AGB outflows on CO spectral lines
arxiv-2507-03583.creator: O. Vermeulen, M. Esseldeurs, J. Malfait, T. Ceulemans, L. Siess, K. Matsumoto, F. De Ceuster, T. Danilovich, C. Landri, L. Decin
arxiv-2507-03583.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by O. Vermeulen, M. Esseldeurs, J. Malfait, T. Ceulemans, L. Siess, K. Matsumoto, F. De Ceuster, T. Danilovich, C. Landri, L. Decin. In the late stage of their evolution, low- to intermediate-mass stars pass through the asymptotic giant branch (AGB) phase. AGB stars are characterised by strong mass loss through dust driven winds. High angular resolution interferometric observations reveal that these winds harbour strong deviations from spherical symmetry, such as spirals and arcs, believed to be caused by hidden (sub-)stellar companions.

arxiv-2507-21253.title: Improving SpGEMM Performance Through Matrix Reordering and Cluster-wise Computation
arxiv-2507-21253.creator: Abdullah Al Raqibul Islam, Helen Xu, Dong Dai, Aydın Buluç
arxiv-2507-21253.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Abdullah Al Raqibul Islam, Helen Xu, Dong Dai, Aydın Buluç. Sparse matrix-sparse matrix multiplication (SpGEMM) is a key kernel in many scientific applications and graph workloads. Unfortunately, SpGEMM is bottlenecked by data movement due to its irregular memory access patterns. Significant work has been devoted to developing row reordering schemes towards improving locality in sparse operations, but prior studies mostly focus on the case of sparse-matrix vector multiplication (SpMV).

arxiv-2511-02624.title: Generalized Witt and Morita equivalences
arxiv-2511-02624.creator: Liang Kong, Yilong Wang, Hao Zheng
arxiv-2511-02624.description: Abstract In this work, we introduce a family of new equivalence relations among fusion categories that are less refined than the usual Morita equivalence. We obtain abelian groups by quotienting these new equivalence relations from the commutative monoids of the equivalence classes of all fusion categories.

arxiv-2511-05290.creator: Tommy Mordo, Omer Madmon, Moshe Tennenholtz
arxiv-2511-05290.description: Abstract . In this paper, we study cooperation in distributed games under network-constrained communication. Building on the framework of Monderer and Tennenholtz (1999), we derive a sufficient condition for cooperative equilibrium in settings where communication between agents is delayed by the underlying network topology. Each player deploys an agent at every location, and local interactions follow a Prisoner’s Dilemma structure.

pmc-10654976.title: The relationship between teacher care behavior and EFL learning anxiety: the chain mediation effect of learning engagement and learning strategies
pmc-10654976.creator: Dongmei Wang
pmc-10654976.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). This study aims to discuss the impact of teacher care behavior on EFL learning anxiety, as well as the mediating role of learning engagement and learning strategies. The Process plugin Model6 was used to measure the interaction between teacher care behavior (TCB), EFL learning anxiety (EFLLA), learning engagement (LE), and English learning strategies (ELS), in order to analyze and summarize their impact characteristics on college students’ EFL learning anxiety.

pmc-11427814.title: Identification of immune infiltration and PANoptosis‐related molecular clusters and predictive model in Alzheimer's disease based on transcriptome analysis
pmc-11427814.creator: Jin‐Lin Mei, Shi‐Feng Wang, Yang‐Yang Zhao, Ting Xu, Yong Luo, Liu‐Lin Xiong
pmc-11427814.description: This study aims to explore the expression profile of PANoptosis‐related genes (PRGs) and immune infiltration in Alzheimer's disease (AD). Based on the Gene Expression Omnibus database, this study investigated the differentially expressed PRGs and immune cell infiltration in AD and explored related molecular clusters.

pmc-11621146.title: Optimum blue light exposure: a means to increase cell-specific productivity in Chinese hamster ovary cells
pmc-11621146.creator: Stefanie Föller, Niklas Regett, Levin Lataster, Gerald Radziwill, Ralf Takors
pmc-11621146.description: Research for biopharmaceutical production processes with mammalian cells steadily aims to enhance the cell-specific productivity as a means for optimizing total productivities of bioreactors. Whereas current technologies such as pH, temperature, and osmolality shift require modifications of the cultivation medium, the use of optogenetic switches in recombinant producer cells might be a promising contact-free alternative.

pmc-12447918.title: Case report: Duplicate renal ureteral malformation with renal tumor, ureteral tumor, renal rupture, calculi and infection
pmc-12447918.creator: Maokun Sun, Baoqun Xu, Heng Zhang, Zhipeng Yan, Lihua Li, Yunji Sun
pmc-12447918.description: IntroductionThe Multiple primary malignant tumors (MPMT) refers to the occurrence of two primary malignant tumors in the same organ or organs in the same patient at the same time. However, MPMT is rare in the urinary system. Congenital urinary tract anomalies (e.g., duplex systems) predispose patients to recurrent infections, stones, and rare malignancies, creating diagnostic and therapeutic challenges.

pmc-12816181.title: Glycolytic reprogramming of resident alveolar macrophages contributes to reduced SOCS3 secretion in non-small cell lung cancer
pmc-12816181.creator: Jennifer M. Speth, Mikel D. Haggadone, Marc Peters-Golden
pmc-12816181.description: Alveolar macrophages (AMs), the resident immune cells of the lung, play a critical role in maintaining pulmonary homeostasis, in part through the secretion of suppressor of cytokine signaling 3 (SOCS3)—a recognized tumor suppressor—within extracellular vesicles (EVs). While we have previously observed that SOCS3 secretion by AMs is diminished in tumor-bearing lungs, the mechanisms underlying this impairment remain unclear.

pmc-13652876.title: A Fine-Grained Longitudinal Study of Adolescent Cannabis Use and Its Relation to Cognitive Performance in Young Adulthood
pmc-13652876.creator: Clarissa Janousch, Urs Grob, Lukas Eggenberger, Lydia Johnson-Ferguson, Denis Ribeaud, Manuel Eisner, Lilly Shanahan, Boris B. Quednow
pmc-13652876.description: Cannabis use in adolescence has been linked to lower adult cognitive function, but the specific contributions of age of onset and usage frequency remain unclear. This study analyzed data from the Zurich Project on Social Development from Childhood to Adulthood (z-proso; N = 1522) to examine associations between adolescent cannabis use and cognitive performance at young adulthood.
